Femi Akinlade  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972 54 321 6543 | f.a@innovatetech.com | linkedin.com/in/femikinlade  

In my role as a QA/Test Engineer at InnovateTech Consulting, I have focused on refining test automation frameworks to ensure alignment with client requirements. Over the past year, I’ve contributed to the execution of 10+ test cases across agile sprints, achieving a 95% pass rate in regression testing. My work has included collaboration with developers to identify and resolve critical bugs, with a particular emphasis on improving the reliability of web applications. At InnovateTech, I’ve also supported the documentation of test procedures, streamlining onboarding for new team members. Prior to this, my part-time role at DevWorks Limited involved automating 20+ test cases using Python and Selenium, which reduced manual testing hours by 30% for a SaaS product. This experience was foundational in developing a structured approach to test automation, which I’ve since applied to multiple projects. My internship at TechNova Solutions further honed my ability to design test strategies, where I contributed to a 15% improvement in defect detection rates by implementing targeted integration tests.  

Technical Skills  
While my current focus is on test automation and quality assurance, I maintain a working knowledge of tools and methodologies that support these efforts. I have implemented basic API testing using Postman to validate endpoints, ensuring data consistency across microservices. CI/CD pipelines are integrated into my workflow through GitHub Actions, where I’ve configured automated test triggers for continuous feedback. Integration testing is approached methodically, with a focus on verifying data flow between systems, though I’ve primarily applied this in controlled environments. JavaScript and Python are used regularly for script development, with Python being central to automating repetitive tasks. REST API design principles are applied when reviewing endpoints, though my contributions to API development remain limited. Selenium and Playwright are utilized for browser automation, with Playwright showing greater compatibility with modern web frameworks. While I have not formalized a test strategy design process, I’ve contributed to ad-hoc documentation that aligns with team standards. Unit testing is conducted selectively, prioritizing critical components of applications.  

Projects  
At DevWorks Limited, I spearheaded the automation of regression tests for a customer portal, reducing manual testing hours by 30% and improving defect resolution times. This involved scripting Python-based test cases to validate user authentication flows and payment integrations. At InnovateTech Consulting, I collaborated on a project to refine test automation for a healthcare SaaS platform, where I designed scripts to simulate user interactions and ensure compliance with accessibility standards. My work included integrating Playwright with the existing test suite, which increased coverage for dynamic UI elements.  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, University of Lagos, 2023. Coursework included software engineering principles, algorithms, and database systems, with a focus on practical applications.  

Languages  
English (fluent), Hebrew (basic).  

Certifications  
Google IT Support Professional Certificate (2023).
